Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

lifestyle — the way you live. Example: My lifestyle is busy.
routine — what you do every day. Example: Her routine is more relaxed.
busy — with a lot of things to do. Example: My lifestyle is busier than yours.
relaxed — calm, without stress. Example: Her routine is more relaxed.
healthy — good for your body. Example: My lifestyle is healthier.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My lifestyle is ... than ...
• It is busier.
• It is more relaxed.
• I sleep more.
• It is healthier.
